title: A Successful Repeated Run Has a Successful Block
statement: Let $q$ map Boolean lists to optional values, let $t$ be a natural number, and let $w$ be a Boolean list. If the repeated run of $q$ on $w$ returns $a$, then there is a Boolean list $u$ of length exactly $t$ on which $q$ returns $a$.
